tours.name: Culebra Island Aquafari (with Ferry Tickets)
tours.description:
Experience the beauty of Culebra Island on this full-day snorkeling adventure from Puerto Rico’s east coast.

Explore the vibrant waters of the Luis Peña Marine Reserve, one of the Caribbean’s most protected and thriving marine ecosystems. Snorkel among colorful tropical fish, coral formations, and keep an eye out for sea turtles gliding through the reef.

After your snorkeling experience, relax at the iconic Flamenco Beach, famous for its soft white sand and turquoise waters. Spend time swimming, exploring, or enjoying lunch from the local beach kiosks while soaking in the incredible scenery.

This guided adventure includes ferry transportation, snorkeling gear, and expert guides, giving you everything you need for a memorable day exploring one of Puerto Rico’s most islands.

Explore the secret gems that Vieques has to offer!

Upon departing marina Puerto Del Rey, our guests will enjoy the beautiful views of the El Yunque Mountains. After approximately 45 minutes, we arrive at the destination, which could be one of many beautiful beaches that Vieques offers like Sun Bay, Blue Beach, Green Beach, or Isla Yayí. tours.name: Los Pozos Jetski Tour
tours.description:
About

You’ll be riding one of our top-of-the-line GTX Sea-Doo jet skis, featuring a sleek design, powerful engine, and smooth handling. The GTX offers a high-performance ride that is both thrilling and comfortable, with spacious seating for up to two passengers—perfect for sharing the fun with a family member or close friend.

Our 30min Los Pozos tour departs from El Combate, taking you just a step away from La Bahia Boquerón. This tour not only offers an exciting jet ski adventure but also a chance to observe marine life. As you speed across the water, you'll arrive at the serene Los Pozos beach, where crystal-clear waters set the perfect backdrop for spotting ocean creatures. Keep an eye out for starfish scattered along the seabed, and if you’re lucky, you might even catch a glimpse of a stingray gliding gracefully through the water. This tour blends the thrill of jet skiing with the beauty of encountering marine life in its natural habitat!

About

Yacht chartering in Icacos and Palomino, Puerto Rico, offers a luxurious experience amidst the Caribbean setting.

A yacht tour in this region provides exclusivity and comfort, with options ranging from small, intimate vessels to larger luxury yachts equipped with crew and amenities such as gourmet dining and water toys.

Whether you're looking for a romantic getaway, a family adventure, or a memorable day with friends, exploring Icacos and Palomino by yacht ensures a personalized Caribbean experience.

Icacos:
Located just off the eastern coast of Puerto Rico, Icacos is a small uninhabited island known for its pristine white sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters.

A yacht charter here typically includes opportunities for snorkeling, swimming, and sunbathing on secluded beaches. The island is surrounded by vibrant coral reefs teeming with marine life, making it a perfect spot for underwater exploration.

Palomino:
Similarly beautiful, Palomino Island is located near the town of Fajardo on the eastern coast of Puerto Rico. It offers a more developed setting with upscale amenities such as beachside bars, water sports rentals, and even horseback riding.

Experience San Juan like never before on our signature City Lights Night Kayak Tour in the heart of the city. As the sun sets and the skyline begins to glow, your adventure begins with a fun check-in where you’ll get your glow on with glow paint and glow sticks—setting the tone for a night on the water.

After a quick and easy Kayak 101 on land, you’ll launch into the calm waters of the lagoon alongside our expert guides. Paddle alongside the mangroves and across the shimmering lagoon while taking in views of the San Juan skyline. Along the way, your guide will share fascinating insights about the estuary, local wildlife, and the history of Puerto Rico.

We’ll pause during the tour for a complimentary photo, capturing the magic of your nighttime kayak adventure. Your guide will also share insider tips on the best nearby beaches, restaurants, and bars to explore during your stay.

With city views, fun storytelling, and an electric nighttime vibe, it’s no surprise this experience is voted #1 online in all of Puerto Rico.

Don’t miss your chance to experience San Juan glowing from the water—city lights all around, glow paint on, and memories that become the highlight of your trip!

tours.name: Nomadic Northwest: Caves, Beaches; Sinkholes, Karstic Mogotes
tours.description:
All Ages • 8 Hours • Every Saturday • Please Call or Email for Additional Dates

Duration

8 Hours

About

The most rewarding area of the island, owing to the magnificent ranges of karstic mogotes, or limestone hillocks, whose likes are only found in a handful of places in the world. Lovely caves and sinkholes are many in this karstic region.
Let's nomadize the Northwest region- the most rewarding area of the island in our full day trip. We'll meet at the famous Lemy bakery in Levittown for authentic breakfast (included). After a 30min. drive in a luxury SUV we'll hike to a unique secret spring that comes out of the earth through the limestone. The forest and the swamp are part of the Tortuguero reserve - the only freshwater lagoon in Puerto Rico. You'll learn about unique flora and fauna and get to soak in the crystal-clear water with medicinal properties. Next, to one of the most photographed beach in Puerto Rico- beautiful natural cove with the iconic half-moon opening. Then off to the sacred Indian Cave, where Taino Indian women were coming to give birth and to conduct ceremonies and rituals in privacy. Woman traditionally ask for love, fertility and happy marriage on this site. We'll continue for a bite to the Food Network Channel favorite "ceti" fritters shack- seasonal authentic Puerto Rican delicacy. On the way back we'll drive along one of the most spectacular drives in Puerto Rico- coastal 681 road with palm lined beaches, bars and iconic Columbus monument.

First, we head to the Central Mountain town of Ciales as we drive through windy roads to the Tres Picachos Rainforest Reserve and Las Delicias waterfall. In these caves you´ll find petroglyphs (rock carvings) left by our Taíno ancestors long ago. Finally, you´ll get a chance to chill at the beach before heading back to your place of stay. Don´t forget to take a lot of pics or you´ll regret it like Bad Bunny!

About

Enjoy a day in "Charco La Barrigona". A beautiful swimming area along the Mameyes River in Río Grande, located in the outskirts of the " El Yunque National Forest."

After a delicious lunch break of local Puerto Rican cuisine you can enjoy the beautiful Luquillo Beach where the view will be more than worth the trip. Then get ready for a night Kayaking adventure to the Island’s amazing Bioluminescent “Laguna Grande” where you will experience the rare phenomenon of glowing, sparkling water, existing in only 4 other places on earth!

One of the most spectacular sights on a night trip in Caribbean waters is to witness hundreds of tiny star-like bioluminescent plankton scintillating like a starry sky as you move through the dark water.
Wave your paddle through the water in front of you, and be mesmerized by the tiny glowing specs of plankton or Dinoflagellates which are tiny unicellular marine plankton also known as fire plants.

Based in Palmas Del Mar, Curate Fishing Charters offers amazing fishing adventures year round. Captain Alberto quit his 9-5 job to pursue the dream of being a full time fishing guide. tours.description: Join a personalized El Yunque rainforest tour with local guides, featuring waterfalls, cliff jumps, and lush scenery. Enjoy a small-group adventure, traditional food, and door-to-door service for an unforgettable day in nature.

tours.name: Palomino or Icacos: Boat Day Trip with Transportation from San Juan to Fajardo
tours.description: Set sail on a small-group boat trip to Puerto Rico’s pristine Icacos or Palomino islands. Swim, snorkel, relax on floating mats, enjoy island vibes, and soak up stunning turquoise waters in a full-day adventure from San Juan.

tours.name: EcoFarm Walking Tour
tours.description: Discover the vibrant world of sustainable farming at Finca Neo Jibairo! Engage with nature as you explore agroecology, learn about Puerto Rican tobacco's cultural significance, and enjoy local products. With expert guidance, this immersive experience connects you to the land, its heritage, and the beauty of sustainable practices.

tours.name: Vieques 24-hr Adventure
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 24-hour adventure on Vieques Island! Enjoy local cuisine, beach time with provided gear, and a mesmerizing bioluminescent bay tour. Experience horseback riding on a black sand beach and unwind under the stars at Casita Azul. This unique getaway promises unforgettable memories and stunning natural beauty.

tours.name: Vieques Beach Adventure
tours.description: Experience the best of Vieques Island in a thrilling 9-hour tour! Enjoy beach time with provided gear, savor a delicious lunch, visit stunning black sand beaches with optional horseback riding, and indulge in dinner at your favorite restaurant. Cap off the day with a magical bioluminescent bay tour.

tours.name: GoCar Puerto Rico: Heritage & Shores Tour
tours.description: Embark on an 8-hour GoCar adventure through San Juan, exploring vibrant colonial streets, historic forts, and stunning coastlines. With a GPS-guided car as your storyteller, discover Puerto Rico's rich culture, savor local cuisine, and shop at unique boutiques. Customize your journey for an unforgettable day of exploration and relaxation.

tours.name: Cave, Mountain & Beach Adventure
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s rich history at Cueva del Indio, hike lush mountains with coffee tastings, then unwind in crystal-clear natural pools at Mar Chiquita Beach—an all-in-one adventure full of culture, nature, and stunning views.

tours.name: Snorkeling
tours.description: Explore vibrant coral reefs and abundant sea life just offshore from Fajardo. Snorkel or dive in calm Caribbean waters, with options for beginners and certified divers. All gear and guides included for a memorable adventure.

tours.name: 45 Minute San Juan Bay Jet Ski Experience
tours.description: Zoom past historic El Morro on a Yamaha jetski, feeling the Caribbean breeze and soaking in stunning views of Old San Juan. Guided by experts, this thrilling ride offers a unique, unforgettable adventure on crystal-clear waters.

priceBreakdown.note: 1 driver (ages 21+) and 1 free passenger (ages 12+) per vehicle

Relax on the water or take a refreshing swim in crystal-clear waves as the sun sets over Puerto Rico. This unique adventure combines stunning views with the tranquility of the sea, creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: The Story of Old San Juan

Experience the beauty of exclusive spots at your own pace, creating unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Party Boat Tour

tours.name: Hidden Beach Tour
tours.description: Escape to a tranquil mangrove walk leading to a secluded beach, perfect for soaking up sun and serenity. Includes gear, water, and transport—ideal for a peaceful, less crowded island adventure.

tours.name: Guavate Tour
tours.description: Embark on a 7-hour adventure through Puerto Rico's stunning mountains, exploring the serene Charco Azul river and indulging in the island's finest local cuisine in Guavate. Enjoy a relaxing escape from the crowds, complete with included snacks, water, and life vests, making this journey both memorable and refreshing.

tours.name: 3 Hours
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 3-hour adventure with Visit Fajardo PR, exploring the stunning islands of Icacos, Palomino, and Piñero. Enjoy snorkeling, beach relaxation, and refreshments aboard the Perlita, a 27' power catamaran, guided by a certified US Coast Guard Captain. Experience the beauty of Puerto Rico's east coast!

tours.name: 4 Hours
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 4-hour adventure with Visit Fajardo PR, exploring the stunning islands of Icacos, Palomino, and Piñero. tours.name: Guided Coral Reef Snorkel Tours

tours.name: Glow Night Diving Tour
tours.description: Dive into the night and see coral reefs glow in vibrant greens, oranges, blues, and pinks with UV lights. A thrilling 2.5-hour adventure perfect for certified divers seeking a colorful underwater spectacle.

tours.name: Kayak Adventures (Snorkeling, Fishing, & More)
tours.description: Paddle along Rincon’s stunning coast, snorkel coral reefs, try kayak fishing, or watch a breathtaking sunset. No experience needed—just bring your swimsuit and sense of adventure for 2.5 to 4 hours of fun.

tours.name: Snorkeling Equipment & Kayak Rentals
tours.description: Explore Rincon’s stunning coral reefs and coastal views with flexible kayak and snorkel rentals. Whether for an hour or all day, dive into an unforgettable Puerto Rican water adventure.

tours.name: Outdoor Rock Climbing Adventure
tours.description: Conquer outdoor rocks with expert guidance in just 5 hours. No experience needed—feel the thrill of reaching your first summit while enjoying all gear and safety instructions included.

tours.name: Fishing & Sailing Charters

tours.name: El Yunque & Luquillo Beach
tours.description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of El Yunque rainforest and Luquillo Beach in a single day! Enjoy a refreshing smoothie and local breakfast before relaxing on the beach. Explore stunning views from the Yokahu observation tower, capture memories at La Coca Falls, and swim in crystal-clear river waters for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Jetski Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable jet ski tour along Vieques' stunning northwest coast. Experience the thrill of piloting your own jet ski while visiting three breathtaking beaches, including the enchanting Green Beach and the secretive black sand beach. Enjoy unique views and a swing at the picturesque 'Secret Spot' for an adventure like no other.

tours.name: Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide through glowing waters in crystal-clear kayaks, witnessing bioluminescent marine life under a starry sky. A magical one-hour adventure in Vieques that immerses you in nature’s luminous wonder.

tours.name: Full Day Private Boat Tour
tours.description: Set sail on a 6-hour adventure to Fajardo’s stunning islands on a comfy boat with music, snacks, snorkeling gear, and floating mats. Bring your favorite drinks and enjoy a day of sun, sea, and discovery.

tours.name: Half Day Private Boat Tour
tours.description: Sail to a stunning island in the Fajardo Keys on a sleek 30ft boat. Enjoy snorkeling, floating mats, fresh snacks, local drinks, and sunbathing—perfect for a relaxing half-day adventure in paradise.

tours.name: Palomino Island 1 hour Island Rush Jet Ski Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of speed and the stunning scenery with our Jet Ski rentals. Glide across the water, feeling the rush of adrenaline as you explore breathtaking landscapes. This unforgettable adventure combines excitement and nature, making it the perfect escape for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike.

tours.name: Palomino Island 30 minute Island Rush Jet Ski Adventure
tours.description: Experience the thrill of speed and the stunning beauty of nature with our exhilarating Jet Ski rentals. Glide across the water, feel the rush of adrenaline, and create unforgettable memories as you explore breathtaking landscapes. This adventure promises excitement and a unique way to connect with the great outdoors.

tours.name: Aqua-Venture San Juan to Culebra Full Day Trip
tours.description: Experience a full day of adventure on Culebra Island, Puerto Rico! Enjoy a scenic ferry ride, relax on the stunning Flamenco Beach, and snorkel among vibrant marine life. With provided beach gear and transportation, this unforgettable day promises sun, sand, and the beauty of nature at its finest.

tours.name: JetSki Rental Rincón
tours.description: Feel the thrill of speeding across the water on a sleek GTX Pro Jet Ski, with chances to spot dolphins and turtles. Safe, fun, and perfect for family adventures or solo escapes.

tours.name: Spa Del Jibaro Tour
tours.description: Embark on a breathtaking journey through lush forests, where you'll swim in natural pools, glide down water slides, and marvel at stunning waterfalls. This moderate tour offers a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, perfect for beginners seeking a memorable experience in nature's beauty. Join us for an unforgettable day!

tours.name: Full Adventure Tour
tours.description: Hike through lush forests, then plunge into waterfalls, whirlpools, and natural waterslides. Tackle cliff jumps, body rafting, and rappelling for an adrenaline-filled adventure in stunning scenery.

tours.name: Via Ferrata
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure with Montaña Explora’s Via Ferrata tour, the only one in Puerto Rico! Climb a mountain using cables, ladders, and bridges, guided by professionals ensuring your safety. Perfect for thrill-seekers in good physical condition, this unforgettable experience promises breathtaking views and unforgettable memories.

tours.name: El Yunque Whisper's Swing And River Tour
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure in El Yunque Rain Forest with Montaña Explora’s Whisper’s Swing and River tour. Hike to the summit for breathtaking views, then experience the thrill of swinging over 700 feet above sea level. This unforgettable journey promises stunning scenery and heart-pounding excitement in Puerto Rico.

tours.name: VIP Private Tour
tours.description: Embark on a personalized adventure with our VIP Private Tour of El Yunque! Tailored to your interests, this exclusive experience offers flexibility and expert guidance through breathtaking locations. Whether you seek adventure, relaxation, or photography, enjoy the forest at your own pace while learning about its rich history and culture.

tours.name: Group Beach Sunset Tour
tours.description: Ride along secluded beaches and quiet dirt roads in Vieques, with stunning views of Culebra and clear waters teeming with fish. Capture unforgettable photos in a small group or private tour—adventure awaits.

tours.name: Moku Surf Camp
tours.description: Experience the thrill of summer at MOKU Surf Camp! Perfect for ages 8-13, this camp offers an unforgettable opportunity to learn surfing, make new friends, and enjoy a safe environment. With all necessary gear provided and refreshing snacks included, it's the ultimate adventure for young surf enthusiasts.

tours.name: Private Charter to Catalina Island
tours.description: Sail your private speedboat to Catalina Island’s turquoise waters, lush beaches, and coconut palms. Enjoy champagne, lobster lunch, and thrilling activities in a VIP setting—an unforgettable Caribbean escape awaits.

tours.name: Recorrido guiado por Mi Viejo San Juan en Español
tours.description: Embark on a captivating journey through the historic streets of Viejo San Juan, the oldest city in Puerto Rico. This unique Spanish-only tour unveils its rich history, legends, and vibrant culture. Stroll along cobblestone paths, explore colorful buildings, and discover the secrets of a city that has stood for over 500 years.

tours.name: South Coast Wahoo Expeditions
tours.description: Dive into 3 days of offshore bluewater spearfishing for wahoo and pelagics, plus reef diving and surfing. Stay steps from the water, with gear and freedom to explore, hunt, or relax in a raw, adventure-filled Caribbean setting.

tours.name: Pavilion/Gazebo Rental/Park
tours.description: Host your special event in our charming pavilion, gazebo, or park, offering a picturesque setting for unforgettable moments. With 4-5 hours of exclusive access, create lasting memories surrounded by nature's beauty, making your occasion truly unique and enjoyable. Experience the perfect backdrop for celebrations of all kinds.

tours.name: Sports Court Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of playing in a unique setting with both roofed and non-roofed court options. Whether you prefer the open air or a sheltered environment, enjoy a memorable 4-5 hour session that caters to your playing style and enhances your game. Perfect for all skill levels!

tours.name: TRIO Zipline, River Slide & Beach Tour

tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as you kayak or paddleboard through stunning waterways, surrounded by breathtaking natural beauty. This unique experience promises excitement and tranquility in one perfect outing.

Make your trip unforgettable with this fun and unique experience!

tours.name: Monster + Beast Transportation Combo

Begin your journey with a breathtaking 47m suspension bridge before soaring high above the landscape. This unforgettable excursion promises excitement and stunning views!

tours.name: CASA BACARDÍ - LEGACY TOUR

tours.name: LED Night Kayak Tour
tours.description: Glide through the vibrant Condado lagoon in a LED kayak, spotting manatees and colorful reefs amid lush mangroves. An eco-adventure blending stunning views, wildlife, and natural beauty for all ages.

tours.name: Horseback Riding at the Beach
tours.description: Ride through Puerto Rico’s lush forests and secluded beaches on a gentle horseback tour. No experience needed—just feel the breeze, see stunning scenery, and escape the crowds in this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: Rum History Tour
tours.description: Step into history at Hacienda Santa Ana, where Ron del Barrilito has been crafted since 1880. Enjoy a complimentary cocktail, explore the grounds, and take home a souvenir glass in this immersive 30-minute tour.

tours.name: Inside El Morro Castle & Old San Juan Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s vibrant streets, stunning views, historic landmarks, lively music, and colorful architecture on a guided tour. Perfect for all ages, it’s a quick dive into Puerto Rico’s rich history and culture.

tours.name: Blazing Bull (2 Zip-lines)
tours.description: Experience the thrill of Blazing Bull, featuring two exhilarating ziplines that let you soar in a lying down position. Launch from a 120-foot tower, glide over a stunning water fountain, and zip back to the Distrito T-Mobile building. This unique adventure promises unforgettable views and an adrenaline rush like no other.

tours.name: Pico del Toro
tours.description: Experience the thrill of the Caribbean's largest indoor rock climbing wall at Pico del Toro! With varying difficulty levels tailored to your abilities, this adventure promises an adrenaline rush like no other. Challenge yourself in a safe environment and conquer new heights in just 30 minutes of exhilarating fun!

tours.name: Rainforest Half Day Adventure
tours.description: Climb Yokahú Tower for stunning views, marvel at La Coca Waterfall, then cool off with a swim in clear river waters. A scenic, moderate adventure through lush El Yunque awaits your discovery.

tours.name: Beach, Sip and DANCE with US
tours.description: Dance on the beach with personalized snacks and drinks, led by expert instructors. Choose gourmet or basic packages, enjoy lively salsa, and create unforgettable memories in Puerto Rico’s stunning seaside setting.

tours.name: Alcapurria Brunch & Bottomless mimosa
tours.description: Embark on a hands-on culinary adventure with "A Taste of Puerto Rico – Alcapurria Brunch." Master the art of crafting alcapurria, transform it into waffles, and mix your own mimosa. Enjoy a full brunch spread while exploring Puerto Rican flavors in this unique and memorable experience. Spaces are limited, so reserve your spot!

tours.name: Half Day Rainforest Tour from the East Coast
tours.description: Embark on a half-day adventure through Puerto Rico's breathtaking rainforest, where you'll explore vibrant flora and fauna on a guided hike. Enjoy a refreshing swim in a crystal-clear river pool, swing from a rope, and indulge in delicious local snacks, creating unforgettable memories in this tropical paradise.

tours.name: West Coast Epic Coastal Journey and Magic Sunset
tours.description: Embark on a unique adventure along Puerto Rico's west coast, exploring hidden gems from Aguadilla to Isabela and Rincón. Experience snorkeling with sea turtles, a scenic jungle trek, and savor local delicacies. Conclude your journey with breathtaking clifftop views of the ocean and a stunning sunset over Desecheo Island.

tours.name: Jetski Adventure
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure as a modern captain at Luquillo Beach, surrounded by the breathtaking El Yunque National Park. Experience the thrill of Yamaha jet skiing with expert guides, ensuring safety and excitement. Capture stunning photos and create lasting memories in this unique aquatic escapade!

tours.name: Sail Catamaran Day Trip (Traveler)
tours.description: Sail to Puerto Rico’s pristine island of Icacos, snorkel vibrant reefs, relax on white beaches, and enjoy tropical drinks. Perfect for families and solo travelers seeking sun, sea, and unforgettable scenery.

tours.name: Piña Colada Experience
tours.description: Dive into the vibrant world of Puerto Rico's iconic Piña Colada! Join us for an immersive experience where you'll craft this refreshing cocktail using fresh ingredients. Perfect for cocktail lovers and those seeking a fun outing, this unique activity promises to be both educational and enjoyable.

tours.name: November Rock Climbing Camp
tours.description: Join an unforgettable fall adventure where kids explore nature through rock climbing, bouldering, and engaging workshops on fossils and minerals. With a focus on fun and learning in a safe, inclusive environment, children set their own climbing goals while enjoying games, campfires, and creative activities.

tours.name: Coquito Sip, Salsa, Merengue and Bachata Beach Dance Class
tours.description: Sway to Latin beats on the beach, learning salsa, bachata, and merengue with friendly instructors. Sip creamy Coquito, enjoy tropical vibes, and dance your heart out in this lively, adults-only oceanfront experience.

tours.name: Sofrito Customized Experiences
tours.description: Dance through the vibrant streets of Old San Juan on a reggaeton tour, where lively beats and colorful sights create an unforgettable rhythm-filled adventure.

tours.name: Catching the Sunset Jetski Tour
tours.description: Glide over crystal waters on a high-performance jet ski as the sun sets over Puerto Rico’s coast. Choose between tranquil Boquerón Bay or dramatic Los Morillos Lighthouse for a breathtaking, unforgettable twilight adventure.

tours.name: Rock Climbing – Puerto Hermina
tours.description: Experience the thrill of rock climbing along Puerto Rico’s stunning northern coast with a private adventure at Puerto Hermina. Guided by experts, conquer 3 to 5 natural limestone routes while soaking in breathtaking ocean views. This half-day excursion promises excitement, skill-building, and relaxation in a beautiful Caribbean setting.

tours.name: Rum & Chocolates
tours.description: Savor three wines paired with rich, handcrafted chocolates in a guided tasting led by a specialist. Indulge your senses with artisanal flavors and expert insights in this exclusive, Spanish-led experience.

tours.name: Nightly Earthship Stay (Eco-Dome Rental)
tours.description: Join a real off-grid adventure at Earthship Puerto Rico, where sustainability, community, and resilience take center stage. Experience solar-powered living, natural cooling, and hands-on eco-education in a peaceful, rustic setting.

tours.name: Explore, Discover, Preserve
tours.description: Explore coral reefs, mangroves, and beaches in a 5-hour adventure of kayaking, snorkeling, and discovery. Learn about coastal conservation while immersing in Puerto Rico’s vibrant ecosystems.

tours.name: Amazing Coast Tour
tours.description: Experience Puerto Rico's rich history from the sky on this captivating helicopter tour. In just 15 to 18 minutes, you'll soar over stunning shorelines and iconic landmarks near Old San Juan, offering a unique perspective of the island's beauty and heritage. Perfect for history enthusiasts and adventure seekers alike!

tours.name: El Russo - Mini Catamaran
tours.description: Sail away on El Russo, a private mini catamaran for up to 6. Swim, snorkel, and relax on pristine beaches with your own captain. Enjoy snacks, drinks, and vibrant marine life in crystal-clear Caribbean waters.

tours.name: Sunset Bio-Bay Kayaying
tours.description: Paddle through Laguna Grande’s stunning Bio Bay at sunset, surrounded by mangroves and vibrant wildlife. Relax, reconnect with nature, and enjoy expert-guided, eco-friendly kayaking in a peaceful 2-hour adventure.

tours.name: Camping - Detrás de la teta
tours.description: Sleep under the stars with stunning mountain views, enjoy peaceful surroundings, a campfire, and fresh mountain air. Relax, rest, and soak in the breathtaking south coast scenery in a safe, quiet setting.

tours.name: Island Hopping and Snorkeling Tours - Full Day
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 6-hour Island Hopping tour, exploring stunning cays like Palomino and Icacos. Enjoy snorkeling at prime spots, bask in the sun on beautiful beaches, and savor a delicious onboard lunch. With customizable options and refreshing drinks included, this adventure promises unforgettable memories and relaxation.

tours.name: Rincón Whale Watching Trips
tours.description: Watch humpback whales breach and sing in their natural habitat. Snorkel alongside these gentle giants, listen to their songs, and enjoy a safe, family-friendly adventure in warm waters from January to April.

tours.name: PHOTO & VIDEO SESSION @IslandWavesRincon
tours.description: Capture unforgettable moments of your surfing or sailing adventure with a professional photo session at local beaches. Over two hours, enjoy stunning images and clips that showcase your skills, tailored to the day's perfect weather and water conditions. Create lasting memories of your time on the waves!

tours.name: Old San Juan & Loiza Historical Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s historic forts, colorful streets, and stunning views. Then dive into Loíza’s African roots, enjoy authentic food at Piñones, meet local artists, and dance to Afro-Caribbean drums in this 7-8 hour cultural adventure.

tours.name: Rainforest Swimming and Beach Adventure
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s outskirts with thrilling rock waterslides, natural pools, and lush hikes. Swim, jump, relax, and soak in stunning scenery on this action-packed, adventure-filled day near the rainforest.

tours.name: Summer Clinics 2025
tours.description: Join our successful Summer Clinics designed for kids ages 6-17, where they can develop and enhance their surfing skills daily. With experienced instructors who are both great surfers and CPR First Aid Certified, this program promises an exciting and safe environment for young surfers to thrive and make unforgettable memories.

tours.name: Kayaking Rental
tours.description: Paddle along Parguera’s shoreline in a two-seater kayak, perfect for solo or small child adventures. Explore ocean waters at your own pace, staying safe near shore with gear, instructions, and a sense of freedom.

tours.name: PADI Specialty Diver Course
tours.description: Enhance your diving skills with expert-led PADI Specialty Courses like Night Diving, Fish ID, or Coral Conservation. Dive deeper, navigate better, and protect reefs—all in 4 hours with gear included.

tours.name: UTV at Forest
tours.description: Feel the thrill of Puerto Rico’s top adventure with an exhilarating UTV ride. Guided by experts, tackle rugged trails, feel the wind, and unleash your wild side in this unforgettable off-road experience.

tours.name: Old San Juan Historical & Shopping
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s rich history, colorful streets, and delicious cuisine on a 4.5-hour bus tour. Walk historic cobblestones, learn fascinating stories, and get inspired for your own adventure in this vibrant, centuries-old city.

tours.name: Vieques Boat Day Trip
tours.description: Snorkel in Vieques' pristine, crystal-clear waters, marvel at vibrant reefs and marine life, all away from crowds. Enjoy expert guidance, eco-interpretation, and local snacks on this unforgettable island adventure.

tours.name: Rum Mixology Tour
tours.description: Learn to craft elegant cocktails with top mixologists using premium rum. Impress guests at your next party with skills gained in this interactive class—perfect for home bartenders seeking a professional touch.

tours.name: River Tubing Adventure
tours.description: Venture into pristine caves and lush forests on a guided tour. Tube through a 1,000-foot underground river, swim in natural pools, hike scenic trails, and relax under waterfalls—an adventure connecting you with nature’s raw beauty.

tours.name: Rum Trails Tasting Experience
tours.description: Journey through Puerto Rico’s rum heritage with tastings of historic and innovative rums, visits to renowned distilleries, and a scenic stop in Old San Juan—an unforgettable 7-8 hour adventure.

tours.name: SJU Airport to Wyndham Grand Rio Mar Rainforest Beach & Golf Resort
tours.description: Relax after your flight with a shared shuttle from San Juan Airport to Wyndham Grand Rio Mar. Book for two adults, bring your own car seat, and enjoy a smooth, hassle-free ride into the lush Puerto Rican rainforest.

priceBreakdown.note: Select this option if you are a single passenger.

tours.description: Experience a breathtaking sunset cruise exclusively for El Conquistador Resort guests. Set sail on Saturdays and indulge in delicious appetizers and refreshing drinks while enjoying stunning views of the El Yunque Mountains and the serene islands of Puerto Rico. Relax as the crew caters to your every need during this memorable evening.

tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour adventure in Bayamon, Puerto Rico, where you'll hike upriver to uncover stunning cascades and natural pools. Experience the thrill of reaching a breathtaking waterfall, all while guided by an expert. Enjoy a comfortable ride and essential amenities for a memorable day in nature.

tours.name: Hidden Gems of the North
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour adventure along Puerto Rico's northern coast. Hike to a hidden crystal-clear spring, swim in its pristine waters, and explore the enchanting Cueva de las Golondrinas, home to swallows. Experience nature's beauty and tranquility while enjoying a unique blend of hiking, swimming, and beach exploration.

tours.name: The Old, The New and The Now; The Updated San Juan City Tour
tours.description: Experience San Juan like never before on this captivating 2 to 2.5-hour city tour. Discover historic sites like Castillo San Cristobal and the San Juan Cathedral, explore vibrant neighborhoods, and enjoy local hotspots such as La Placita de Santurce. This unique journey blends culture, history, and modern charm for an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: From the Concrete Jungle to the Actual Jungle, The Complete Package Tour
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-6 hour tour of Puerto Rico, exploring the historic Old City of San Juan, iconic landmarks, and the stunning north coast. Experience delicious local street food, delve into the rich culture of ancient caves, and immerse yourself in the lush El Yunque Rain Forest, complete with a refreshing swim.

tours.name: SCUBA Reactivate & Refresh
tours.description: Refresh your diving skills in just 3 hours with a hands-on review and open water dive in Old San Juan. Perfect for returning divers, it boosts confidence and ensures safety before your Puerto Rico adventure.

tours.name: Transfers:  San Juan (Ports, Hotels, AirBnB) TO or FROM  Dorado.
tours.description: Experience the convenience of Herrera Taxi PR, your private and professional transportation service in Puerto Rico. Enjoy safe, timely rides to and from the airport, hotels, and cruise terminals, ensuring a seamless travel experience. Perfect for small groups, this service guarantees comfort and reliability throughout your journey.

tours.name: Transfers:  San Juan (Ports, Hotels, AirBnB) TO or FROM  Rio Grande / Fajardo / Luquillo / Loiza.
tours.description: Experience the convenience of Herrera Taxi PR, providing private and professional transportation across Puerto Rico. Whether you're heading to the airport, hotels, or cruise terminals, enjoy a safe and timely ride tailored for your group. Discover the island with ease and comfort, making your journey memorable and hassle-free.

tours.name: Transfers:  San Juan (Ports, Hotels, AirBnB) TO or FROM  San Juan / Carolina.
tours.description: Experience the convenience of Herrera Taxi PR, your private and professional transportation service in Puerto Rico. Enjoy safe, timely rides to and from the airport, hotels, and cruise terminals, ensuring a smooth journey throughout the island. Perfect for groups, this service guarantees a memorable travel experience.

tours.name: Transfers:  San Juan SJU to Humacao
tours.description: Experience the luxury of private transportation in Puerto Rico, seamlessly connecting you from San Juan International Airport, hotels, or cruise ports to Humacao. Enjoy personalized service and comfort, whether traveling during the day or night, making your journey memorable and stress-free as you explore the island's beauty.

tours.name: Cave Adventure Tour
tours.description: Embark on a thrilling 5-hour adventure into the heart of the island, exploring a lush tropical forest and the stunning Morovis River. Discover ancient rock art and marvel at unique cave formations while hiking along picturesque paths. This unforgettable experience combines natural beauty with rich cultural heritage.

tours.name: Gay Beach Adventure – Queer-Friendly Getaway in Puerto Rico
tours.description: Join a unique queer-led beach adventure that invites LGBTQ+ travelers and allies to a breathtaking, secluded beach. Enjoy swimming in tide pools, relaxing on soft sand, and connecting with like-minded individuals. Guided by local LGBTQ+ experts, this inclusive experience promises fun, nature, and celebration in a tropical paradise.

tours.name: Rainforest Nature Escape: LGBTQ+ Cultural & Ecological Adventure in Puerto Rico
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 5-hour adventure through Puerto Rico's hidden rainforest, away from the crowds. Discover volcanic rock formations, vibrant wildlife, and a sacred natural pool steeped in myth. This exclusive journey promises an unforgettable exploration of nature's beauty, complete with transportation for a seamless experience.

tours.name: Camuy Cave Exploration, Sunset Salsa Class, and Bomba Dance Experience
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s underground caves, dance sunset salsa on the beach, and learn vibrant Bomba rhythms. An unforgettable mix of natural wonders and rich cultural traditions in one full-day adventure.

tours.name: Coamo Hot Springs, Ponce Tour & Lajas Bioluminescent Boat Tour
tours.description: Relax in Coamo’s mineral-rich hot springs, explore Ponce’s art and history, then marvel at glowing bioluminescent waters in Lajas. A full-day adventure blending relaxation, culture, and nature’s magic.

tours.name: Tour Guide Services
tours.description: Experience the rich history and vibrant culture of Puerto Rico through captivating storytelling with a seasoned guide. With over 25 years of expertise, you'll explore local cuisine, historical sites, and stunning trails, all while enjoying personalized insights from a renowned tour designer who has guided dignitaries and travel journalists alike.

tours.name: Get Wet with the Snorkel Crew!
tours.description: Dive into clear waters with a PADI pro, exploring vibrant marine life near Escambrón. Enhance your skills, spot colorful fish and turtles, and enjoy expert guidance—all equipment included in this 1.5-hour adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Hiking Tour from the East Coast
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 6-hour hike through El Yunque Rainforest, the only tropical rainforest in the US National Forest system. Ascend to the breathtaking Mt. Britton observation tower for stunning panoramic views, visit the majestic La Coca Falls, savor authentic Puerto Rican cuisine, and swim in the pristine Río Mameyes.

tours.name: Rainforest Night Magic!!!
tours.description: Embark on a mesmerizing night adventure in the Puerto Rican rainforest, where you'll be serenaded by Coquí frogs and enchanted by glowing fireflies. Experience a rejuvenating waterfall massage and learn from expert guide Andres as you explore this magical ecosystem. This unforgettable journey promises a unique connection with nature.

tours.name: Daily Bike Rentals
tours.description: Experience the island like never before with a bike rental! Available from 9am for up to 12 hours, this adventure allows you to explore at your own pace. Enjoy the stunning scenery while ensuring you stay hydrated and fueled, as you navigate the less-traveled roads during daylight.

tours.name: Toro Pass Transportation Combo
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating 8-hour adventure through Puerto Rico's stunning mountains with the Toro Pass Transportation. Experience the thrill of 8 ziplines, including "The Beast," one of the world's longest, and "The Monster," the longest in America, reaching speeds up to 95 mph. Safety and comfort are prioritized throughout this unforgettable journey.

tours.name: Hobie Getaway Coastal Sail
tours.description: Embark on an exhilarating one-hour sailing adventure along the stunning coast of Rincon, Puerto Rico. Experience hands-on sailing as you and your group actively participate in the journey. Be prepared to get wet and enjoy the thrill of the ocean while surrounded by breathtaking scenery.

tours.name: Hobie Getaway Rental
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing in Rincón aboard a Hobie Getaway! Enjoy a 1-2 hour adventure tailored to wind and weather conditions, with a thorough orientation to ensure safety. Perfect for able swimmers, this unforgettable outing promises excitement and the chance to connect with nature—just remember to bring your bathing suit!

tours.name: Guided Sailing Experience
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing with the Guided Sailing Experience in Rincon! Take the helm of a Hobie Getaway while an expert guide shares tips on navigating the dynamic coastal waters. Perfect for adventurous swimmers, this unforgettable journey promises excitement and local insights as you embrace the wind and waves.

tours.name: Mexico Orcas Seafari (May 2026)
tours.description: Dive into Baja's waters to see orcas hunting mobulas, swim with blue whales, dolphins, and sea lions. A 7-day adventure filled with stunning wildlife, vibrant culture, and unforgettable ocean encounters await you.

tours.name: Meet up and follow Rainforest Adventure!! *Fajardo only* | 6:30am start | ONLY AVAILABLE DECEMBER AND MARCH
tours.description: Explore El Yunque’s lush trails, swim down natural water slides, swing on ropes, and jump into crystal-clear pools. Capture family memories, learn about wildlife, and enjoy a fun, adventurous rainforest experience.

tours.name: Paint, Walk & Sangria
tours.description: Create your own vibrant masterpiece inspired by San Juan’s iconic sights, then stroll through historic cobblestone streets filled with colorful architecture, colonial charm, and fascinating stories.

tours.name: Transporte a las Fiestas de San Sebastian 2026
tours.description: Soar above San Sebastián's lively streets or descend into Puerto Rico's vibrant festivities with a helicopter ride—an unforgettable way to see the city’s energy from the sky.

tours.name: Transport
tours.description: Travel at your own pace with a flexible, custom transport service designed to suit your unique plans and destinations. Enjoy seamless, personalized journeys wherever you want to go.

tours.name: Cave Adventure Day
tours.description: Escape the city for a day of adventure: explore caves with ancient Taino drawings, relax on beaches, visit a local market, and enjoy authentic Puerto Rican cuisine—all in six unforgettable hours.

tours.name: Private Airport Transportation
tours.description: Travel smoothly with a private van for your family, including luggage and a friendly greeter. Enjoy hassle-free roundtrip service with convenient pick-up and drop-off—skip the taxi line and relax.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest & Bio Bay Tour
tours.description: Hike through lush El Yunque rainforest with mountain views and waterfall swims, then paddle at night in glowing Bioluminescent Bay, experiencing Puerto Rico’s natural magic in one unforgettable 11-hour adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest Tour
tours.description: Hike through El Yunque’s lush rainforest, listen to coqui frogs, see stunning waterfalls, and enjoy a beach stop. All gear, guides, and refreshments included—perfect for adventure-loving families ready for nature’s magic.

tours.name: Old San Juan Sunset Walking Tour
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s vibrant streets, stunning views, rich history, lively music, and colorful architecture on a guided walking tour—perfect for all ages to experience Puerto Rico’s heart and soul.

tours.name: Bioluminescent Bay Kayak Tour
tours.description: Paddle through glowing mangrove channels at Laguna Grande, marveling at microscopic planktons in a magical bio bay adventure perfect for families. All gear, guides, and refreshments included.

tours.name: Private Boat Day Trip
tours.description: Sail along Puerto Rico’s stunning east coast on a private 31 ft. boat, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, relax on white sand beaches, and enjoy snacks and drinks—all in a carefree, family-friendly adventure.

tours.name: Horseback Riding at the Forest
tours.description: Ride through lush valleys and wetlands on horseback, soaking in stunning views and vibrant wildlife. Perfect for families, with guided tours from a private farm—adventure awaits in this unique ecosystem.

tours.name: ATV Adventure
tours.description: Feel the thrill of Puerto Rico’s most talked-about ATV rides, racing through rugged trails and stopping at Mameyes River. Perfect for all skill levels—an adrenaline-packed adventure you won’t forget.

tours.name: Forest Zipline Adventure
tours.description: Soar through Puerto Rico’s lush mountains on five thrilling ziplines, cross canopy bridges, and enjoy scenic forest hikes. Feel the wind, see stunning views, and leave worries behind on this unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: El Yunque Rainforest - Drive Yourself & Meet your Guide
tours.description: Explore El Yunque rainforest with a thrilling 4-hour adventure: hike to a hidden water park, swing on ropes, slide into clear pools, and jump from cliffs up to 30ft. Perfect for nature lovers seeking fun and tranquility.

tours.name: Sail Catamaran Day Trip
tours.description: Sail to Puerto Rico’s pristine Icacos Island, snorkel vibrant reefs, relax on white beaches, enjoy tropical drinks, and savor delicious food. Perfect for families and solo travelers seeking sun, sea, and adventure.

tours.name: Kayaks for rent
tours.description: Glide smoothly across calm waters in a solo kayak, feeling the gentle splash of water and the breeze on your face as you explore scenic shores at your own pace.

tours.name: Explore The Mountains - Hiking and Waterfalls Puerto Rico
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden mountain trails, waterfalls, and lush forests on a challenging yet rewarding hike. Enjoy panoramic views, ancient trees, natural pools, and a tasty local meal in a private reserve.

tours.name: Camuy Caves Transportation
tours.description: Explore the awe-inspiring Rio Camuy Caves, home to ancient stalactites, stalagmites, and a rushing underground river. A ranger-led tour reveals geological wonders in Puerto Rico’s third-largest cavern system.

tours.name: San Juan Historic Tour & Beach Combo
tours.description: Explore San Juan’s colonial charm with stunning forts, lively squares, and hidden treasures. Enjoy 5.5 hours of history, vibrant sights, and relaxing moments in this beautiful, historic city.

tours.name: River, Sand and Sun Combo ( Luquillo gems )
tours.description: Enjoy a 5.5-hour adventure through crystal-clear rivers, lush tropical scenery, and the cool ocean. Savor diverse foods at Los Kioskos de Luquillo and taste the national drink—an unforgettable island experience.

tours.name: Central Mountain Range of Puerto Rico-Hiking, Waterfalls & Coffee Shop-Full Day
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s hidden mountain treasures with a thrilling hike, stunning waterfalls, lush forests, and a private reserve. Enjoy fresh fruits, coffee, and panoramic views in an unforgettable adventure.

tours.name: San Salvador Rainforest Hiking & Rappelling
tours.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Puerto Rico's Carite Rainforest, where you'll hike through stunning landscapes and experience thrilling rappelling at two breathtaking waterfalls. Enjoy fresh tropical fruits, a delicious homemade meal, and panoramic views, all while exploring the island's hidden natural beauty. Perfect for physically fit adventurers!

tours.name: Bar & Restaurants Chinchorreo
tours.description: Explore Puerto Rico’s heart in 5.5 hours with tasty food, local drinks, lively music, and warm locals. Travel scenic roads, enjoy cultural stops, and take home authentic souvenirs—an unforgettable family adventure.

tours.name: Old San Juan & Isla Verde Beach
tours.description: Explore Old San Juan’s colorful streets, historic forts, and charming plazas. Visit the vibrant Convention District, dance at La Placita, and relax on Isla Verde’s stunning beaches—all in just five hours.

tours.name: Decide Where and When to Dance With US
tours.description: Join a lively Puerto Rican dance class anywhere—beach, backyard, or rooftop. Learn Salsa, Merengue, Bachata, or Reggaetón with expert instructors. No experience needed—just bring your energy and move to the island’s rhythms.

tours.name: La Parguera Keys' Hopping Tour
tours.description: Experience an unforgettable 8-hour adventure in the Caribbean Sea! Snorkel and swim in crystal-clear waters as you explore the stunning mangrove islands of Cayo Caracoles and Cayo Mata La Gata. With a knowledgeable tour guide and a private boat, this journey promises unique sights and memorable moments.

tours.name: FATHER'S DAY PROMO
tours.description: Bring a dad or father figure and choose one activity—get a second entry free. Perfect for sharing special moments, whether kayaking or another adventure, with double the fun at no extra cost.

tours.name: Foodie Tour in the Countryside, Blue Pond and Coffee Plantation
tours.description: Embark on a captivating 1-hour and 15-minute tour through a stunning hacienda, featuring a scenic 20-minute hike to the mesmerizing Charco Azul Blue Pond. Enjoy a refreshing swim in its crystalline waters, followed by a delicious lunch at the renowned El Rancho Original, famous for its roasted pork and culinary acclaim.

tours.name: Mid-Day Snorkeling Private Sail
tours.description: Transform your special occasion into an unforgettable experience with our exclusive event services. Whether it's a proposal, wedding, anniversary, or graduation, we provide a tailored boat and dedicated crew to ensure your celebration is spectacular. Let us handle the details while you create lasting memories.

tours.name: Family Package Ticket
tours.description: Enjoy a thrilling day with family-friendly zipline combos, climbing towers, and roller rides. Choose your adventure, stay safe, and create unforgettable memories in just 3 or 8 hours of fun.

tours.name: Snorkeling Tour Isla Caja de Muertos
tours.description: Sail to Isla Caja de Muertos, a hidden paradise with white beaches and clear waters. Snorkel, relax, and enjoy local lunch on a safe, comfortable boat with expert guides. An unforgettable Caribbean adventure awaits.

tours.name: Hiking Patillas Tour
tours.description: Explore Patillas' stunning rivers, lakes, and waterfalls on a flexible 2- or 4-hour adventure. Hike, swim in natural pools, and enjoy scenic views—perfect for families seeking nature’s thrill and tranquility.

tours.name: 2 Tank Dives for Certified Divers - Individual Ticket Availability
tours.description: Experience exclusive scuba diving trips designed for certified divers, with a maximum of six participants for personalized attention from a PADI divemaster. Explore stunning reefs up to 85 feet deep, all while enjoying a small group atmosphere. Join us on weekends for an unforgettable underwater adventure!

tours.name: Foilboarding
tours.description: Experience the thrill of hydrofoiling with our exciting one-hour session! Whether you're SUP Foiling, Foil Surfing, or Wing Surfing, you'll discover a unique sensation that elevates your water sports adventure. Join us for an unforgettable ride that will redefine your time on the water!

tours.name: Sailing
tours.description: Experience the thrill of sailing on a hobbie cat wave for an hour, guided by your personal skipper. Explore the stunning Isla Verdes Nature Reserve and glide through the picturesque Cangrejos bridge and Balneario de Carolina, making unforgettable memories on the water while learning the art of sailing.

tours.name: Two day bike rental
tours.description: Experience the freedom of overnight biking with a secure lock provided for your convenience. Enjoy the thrill of exploring at your own pace, knowing your bike is safe and ready for your next adventure. Make the most of your journey and create unforgettable memories on two wheels!

tours.name: Weekly Bike Rental
tours.description: Book a week in advance and enjoy a $50 discount per bike, per day, totaling $300 off! Each bike comes fully equipped with a helmet, lock, truck bag, spare tube, tire levers, and a hand pump, ensuring a safe and convenient ride for your adventure.

tours.name: Three day bike rental
tours.description: Join us for an exciting biking adventure starting at 9am in Esperanza! Enjoy the unique experience of keeping your bike overnight, allowing you to explore the area at your leisure. Return your bike by 7pm on the third day, making unforgettable memories along the way.

tours.name: Four Day Bike Rental
tours.description: Experience the freedom of exploring at your own pace with a four-day bike rental. Perfect for adventurers and casual riders alike, this opportunity allows you to discover scenic routes and hidden gems while enjoying the fresh air and exercise. Make unforgettable memories on two wheels!

tours.name: Two Week Bike Rental
tours.description: Book your bike adventure two weeks in advance and enjoy a fantastic discount of over $10 per bike, per day. Each rental includes essential gear like a helmet, lock, and trunk bag, ensuring a memorable and hassle-free ride. Experience the freedom of cycling with everything you need at your fingertips.

tours.name: Six Day Bike Rental
tours.description: Book your bike adventure six days in advance and enjoy an $80 discount per bike, per day! For just $270, each rental includes a helmet, lock, and a truck bag equipped with a spare tube, tire levers, and a hand pump, ensuring a safe and enjoyable ride.

tours.name: Ocean Club San Juan: Salsa Class + Cocktail Included
tours.description: Join a lively salsa class at a beachfront spot in Puerto Rico, then dance the night away with locals. No experience needed—just bring your energy, wear light clothes, and enjoy authentic Caribbean nightlife.
